subject: Vendor portal enrollment matrix and QnA for Orbiton Health
messages:
From: Derek Patel <derek.patel@orbitonhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Orbiton Health Security <security@orbitonhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor security intake: getting Redwood enrolled in our portal

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for following up earlier on the call. We want to get Redwood set up in our vendor portal so we can complete the SIG/CAIQ and collect SOC 2 artifacts. Our security intake requires: a portal account (Whistic/Vendr/OneTrust), a scoped CAIQ, and a sample syslog or retention policy PDF.

Quick questions to help us plan:
- Which portal do you prefer for Orbiton (Whistic preferred, but we can accept Vendr or OneTrust links)?
- Who at Redwood will be the upload owner (so we can send invites)?
- Do you have an approximate ETA for an initial evidence upload (we'd like something within 5 business days if possible)?

I attached a short security summary for internal review. We can also accept a presigned S3 upload if that's easier for your engineering team.

Appreciate any timeline you can share — we have a compliance window for our procurement team.

Thanks,
Derek Patel
Head of Vendor Risk
Orbiton Health
security@orbitonhealth.com

Attachment: Orbiton_Security_Summary.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Derek Patel <derek.patel@orbitonhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor security intake: getting Redwood enrolled in our portal

Hi Derek —

Thanks, glad to get Orbiton moving. Short plan and owners below:

1) Portal choice and invite
- We can accept Whistic or Vendr. For fastest turnaround we'll provision a Whistic upload (single-owner flow) unless you prefer Vendr. Please confirm which portal you can accept.

2) Owners and contacts
- Primary upload owner (Redwood): Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwoodinference.com) — handles Whistic uploads and evidence mapping.
- Technical contact (if you need service-account presign): Jonas Weber (jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com).

3) Initial artifacts we will upload within the first 72 hours after receiving the invite or presigned link:
- Scoped CAIQ export
- SOC 2 summary (scope and date)
- Retention policy + syslog proof (sample)
- KMS/key management diagram (redacted)

4) Timeline
- If we get a portal invite today, Ben will complete a first-pass upload in 2 business days (ETA Mon-Tue next week). If you prefer presigned S3, Jonas can request a temporary service account with uploads the same day.

Attached is an "enrollment matrix" that maps who from Redwood will upload each artifact and the expected file names. It also includes suggested CAIQ sections we typically populate for health customers.

Next steps:
- Derek: confirm portal type (Whistic or Vendr) and the email to send the invite to (or indicate presign).
- Ben: once invite received, will start mapping doc names and upload cadence.

Thanks — I can loop in Product Security if you want a quick walkthrough call.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Manager, Customer Security
Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: portal-enrollment-matrix-20261204.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-orbiton-enroll

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor security intake: getting Redwood enrolled in our portal

Tessa — copying the plan into my tracker and taking ownership of Whistic uploads. A few operational notes:

- I will be the Whistic uploader for Orbiton and will finalize the filename scheme in the matrix (SOC2-summary_vYYYY-MM.pdf, CAIQ-export.json, retention-policy_v1.pdf).
- If we go Vendr instead, I need the API key from Orbiton to stage a bulk export; otherwise manual upload is fine for the first batch.
- Jonas: please provision the presign flow as a fallback (I expect Orbiton will prefer an in-portal upload, but presigned S3 is much faster if they have an internal backlog).
- I'll also request a short exception window from Procurement if they need additional attestation time.

Leaving the calendar tentative for a 30-min walkthrough with Orbiton next Tue to go over the matrix and required fields.

Ben
Director, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor security intake: getting Redwood enrolled in our portal

Hi Tessa / Ben,

Thanks — Orbiton can accept Whistic uploads. Please send the invite to ben.carter@redwoodinference.com and copy security@orbitonhealth.com.

We prefer everything uploaded to the portal for our QA, but if your team runs into rate limits we will accept a presigned S3 link for the initial bundle. I confirmed internally that we can give you a 7-business-day window from invite to initial evidence upload.

I'll look out for Ben's invite acceptance and confirm when Orbiton has the portal account provisioned. If it helps, we can do a 20-minute walkthrough tomorrow afternoon PST.

Appreciate the quick response — looking forward to the first upload.

Best,
Derek
Head of Vendor Risk
Orbiton Health
